## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
Tableau pratique!

A dataframe is flexible matrix, you still have a rectangle but not drawers are the same type.
But not so fast,
this is based on practical concept, I interview 100 persons about name, age, gender, I will have one column for character, a second as integer, and a third a boolean.
So in order words, a data.frame is a collection of **vector of same length**
This is what you format your data.

the other useful feature of a data frame is that you can name the column (also the row), and instead of getting say bahut[, 1] you use bahut$name.
This makes the code much more usable and more orriented with



## Formal {.unnumbered}

bahut["name"] # notice we use "" because it is a character not an object

but we can do bahut[, c("name", "gender")] as in matrix

Construction is vector based
